title: NFTHackST
tagline: NFTHackST is an NFT factory for minting recording artist community social tokens
description: This project is an NFT factory for minting recording artist community social tokens that can be used for purchasing music community merchandise, purchasing concert tickets and give community members access to other items such as NFTs issued by a recording artist or music community before the general public.
how_its_made: NFTHackST was built using the Truffle Polygon Box as its shell. The shell was used for the savings of deploying, transferring and trading NFTs on platforms such as Opensea.io. An NFT factory was added through an ERC1155 contract that pushes images to IPFS with a resulting URL that points to the image, creates a metadata .json file and deploys the NFT to the Polygon blockchain.
